title: Anne-Marie Maman is building a GCEC workshop around the book — 'How Founding Documents Can Ground Your Ethics', stemming from 'my love of the fantastic new book Incorruptible'
summary: Anne-Marie Maman — entrepreneurship leader and startup/venture strategist — is running a workshop at the Global Consortium of Entrepreneurship Centers conference in Florida in October, built on the book. GCEC is the association of university entrepreneurship centers, which puts the book's governance material in front of the people who design how entrepreneurship gets taught.
blockquote: I'll be running a workshop on Saturday, "How Founding Documents Can Ground Your Ethics", stemming from my love of the fantastic new book #Incorruptible, by Eric Ries.  Would love to have you join me in a discussion about how to make sure your mission stays central as you grow your company.
